meta.title: 订阅控制请求从公开入口到持久化回执

controlContract.modify: ModifySubscriptionControlRequest { action:'modify', newPolicy: ExecutionPolicyDefinition, newPolicyHash, confirmationRef, expectedPolicyRevision, expectedScheduleRevision, idempotencyKey, requestedAt }
controlContract.receipt: SubscriptionControlReceipt { subscriptionId, action, status, policyRevision, scheduleRevision, idempotencyKey, requestHash, supersededUnclaimedOccurrences, controlRef }
controlContract.productionEntry: packages/app/src/ui-runtime/server.ts POST /api/plans/{subscriptionId}/control；subscriptionId 来自 URL，body 只允许 { action:'pause'|'resume'|'cancel-future', idempotencyKey, requestedAt }；expectedPolicyRevision 由 UiRuntimeService.controlExecutionPlan 从 SubscriptionControlPort.snapshot 读取当前权威 revision 后补齐，调用方不能声明 revision，因此生产入口不会成为第二条控制真源；expectedScheduleRevision 对该入口非必填故不发送：契约里它对 pause/resume/cancel-future 是可选项，而 scheduleRevision 在每次 applied control 后都会前进，发送刚读到的值会让同一请求的诚实重放变成 conflict，而不是 port 本来就能判定的 durable duplicate；状态合法性仍由事务内的 invalid-state 守卫裁决
controlContract.reminderRecovery: commit_subscription_control atomically invalidates each pending reminder whose subscriptionId, scheduleRevision, and occurrenceOrdinal are superseded by modify, pause, or cancel-future; reminders are not a second control truth
linearization: control does not depend on due_occurrence; pause/resume/cancel-future commit a durable receipt even when no due slot exists
control committed before claim supersedes old unclaimed occurrences; claim rechecks committed state and revision and returns typed stale/conflict
claim committed before control keeps the authorized immutable policy snapshot for that executionEpoch; future pause/cancel-future does not stop in-flight execution
two modifies from the same base revision produce exactly one applied receipt and typed stale/conflict for the losers
duplicate idempotencyKey with the same requestHash returns the existing receipt; different content returns conflict
resume generates deterministic future slots and never reissues superseded occurrences
journal restart replay restores committed subscription state and receipts

terminalContract.failure: typed control rejection before transaction commit; subscription unchanged and no success receipt
terminalContract.reminderInvalidation: superseded pending reminders and their matching unclaimed occurrences become invalidated in the same transaction

executionModeContract.once: once 策略只允许单个 dueAt 触发；create 后 schedule 或 claim 只能消费一个 occurrence
executionModeContract.scheduled: scheduled 策略只允许 startAt 触发；到点后由同一条控制事务驱动一个 occurrence
executionModeContract.recurring: recurring 策略按 intervalMinutes/cadence 生成多个 occurrence；pause 或 cancel-future 只失效未 claim 的 future slots

meta.occurrenceIsolation: 每个 occurrence 使用 subscriptionId、scheduleRevision、occurrenceOrdinal、dueAt 稳定身份；resume 生成新的未来槽位，不回写或复活已失效槽位
meta.productionWiringGap: 两条边均已接线。create 边：已确认草稿 revision 的 executionPolicy 经 packages/app/src/ui-runtime/service.ts 的 UiRuntimeService.persistAuthorizedExecutionPlan 落到 SubscriptionControlPort.create 落成 Subscription。control 边：UiRuntimeService.controlExecutionPlan 是唯一的 control 调用点，公开入口是 packages/app/src/ui-runtime/server.ts 的 POST /api/plans/{subscriptionId}/control（plan-scoped，不要求该 plan 已有 coordinator task），请求体只携带 action/idempotencyKey/requestedAt，subscriptionId 由 URL 提供，policyRevision 由服务端从权威快照读取而非由调用方声明；deleteTask/bulkTaskAction('delete') 删除任务时对孤立 plan 复用同一 control 边执行 cancel-future。真实剩余缺口：(1) 契约的 modify action 在 production 入口仍未开放（无 confirmationRef 收集面），提交 modify 会被入口以 typed 错误拒绝；(2) control 只覆盖 pause/resume/cancel-future 的即时状态迁移，尚无到期时间线预览端点（nextDueAt 由 dashboard 投影从持久化 policy 计算）；(3) 执行停止与计划控制是两条独立边：stop(taskId) 只停当前执行、不修改 plan，销毁计划必须走 cancel-future；删除任务（deleteTask/bulkTaskAction('delete')）会使 plan 成为孤儿，因此删除路径复用同一 control 边提交 cancel-future
meta.productionWiringEvidence: packages/runtime/src/subscriptions/index.ts SubscriptionControlPort.create/control；packages/app/src/ui-runtime/service.ts UiRuntimeService.persistAuthorizedExecutionPlan/controlExecutionPlan/executionPlanForTask；packages/app/src/ui-runtime/server.ts POST /api/plans/{subscriptionId}/control 与 GET /api/tasks/{taskId}/dashboard 的 plan 字段；tests/app/plan-control.test.ts 生产同入口黑盒用例
